skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the theoretical foundations of hotels, hospitality business, and travel accommodation, including their characteristics.
Analyze the core concepts such as hotel customers and products.
Describe and analyze the historical development and future trends of the hotel industry globally and in Vietnam.
Understand and differentiate various types of accommodation facilities, hotels, and hotel rating standards.
Understand and apply knowledge about hotel management activities such as human resource management, technical facilities, procurement, marketing, service quality, etc.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Relationship Between Hotel Businesses and Tourism Service Providers
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the relationship between hotel businesses and tourism service providers such as travel agencies and tour operators.
Understand and apply knowledge about hotel investment and development processes, including new construction, renovation, and expansion.
Perform basic management function activities such as human resource management, marketing and sales, service quality, technical facilities, etc.
Analyze and propose organizational management models for hotel businesses.
Handle situations arising during the operation and management of hotels in Vietnam and around the world.
